title: Du‘as
intro: Duas are our requests to Allah – in Salah we make them after the salawat.

learn.html:
My Allah, thanks be to You,
the little children pray to You –
accept our duas, O Lord,
You are the One who can do all things.
Duas are our requests to the Almighty Allah. In Salah we make them in the last sitting, after the salawat:

learn.label: Rabbanaa aatinaa
learn.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
learn.tr: Rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa ‘adhaaban-naar.
learn.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the next, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

learn.label: Rabbanaghfir lee
learn.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
learn.tr: Rabbanaghfir lee wa li-waalidayya wa lil-mu’mineena yawma yaqoomul-hisaab.
learn.en: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and all the believers on the Day of Judgement.

learn.title: ⭐ In the last sitting
learn.html: At-Tahiyyat – good words to Allah. Salawat – blessings on Muhammad (SAW). Duas – our requests to Allah.

practice.title: Match the dua and meaning
pairs: Our Lord, give us good in this world
Our Lord, forgive me and my parents

questions.q: When do we make duas in Salah?
options: In the last sitting, after the salawat

questions.q: For whom do we ask forgiveness in “Rabbanaghfir lee”?
options: Me, my parents and all believers
